t: This augment can only be added to the $(l:modules/dropper)Dropper/$ and $(l:modules/flinger)Flinger/$ modules.$(p)It can be stacked; each augment added will increase the pickup delay on dropped/flung items by 10 ticks (0.5 sec). This can be useful if you don't want players accidentally picking up nearby dropped items, for example.
这个增强件只能添加到$(l:modules/dropper)投掷器/$和$(l:modules/flinger)抛掷术/$模块中。$(p)它可以叠加；每添加一个增强件，掉落/抛出的物品拾取延迟就会增加 10 tick（0.5 秒）。例如，如果你不希望玩家误捡附近掉落的物品，它就会很有用。
